answer: Offers issued before February 1, 2026 keep their original terms, so your December 2025 offer was good for 7 days or 300 additional miles, whichever came first. That means you could add up to 300 miles, as long as the 7 days hadn't run out first. If the offer has expired, you can request a new one at any time; the new amount reflects current market prices and may be higher or lower.
